decisions.reason: Strong demonstrated use by a major public customer and connections to more than 30 government APIS schemes place this product above aspiration, so we keep it.

This training module fits our trainer capabilities and existing client base, and with organisational slack we continue it while evidence is still incomplete rather than treating it as a clear shortfall.

After another year with only weak visible evidence, this more speculative system appears below aspiration and we would reallocate resources through problemistic search to stronger core and new development projects.
The web platform is close to our established airport and document-checking business, so despite limited public proof we keep it because the strategic fit and learning value still justify support.
